title: 第294章 一个鸡蛋！
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

平时大家都是绕着走的。

因为后墙和山洞中间有一个不小的土包。

擅长开铲车的士兵，开着铲车，几下就把这个土包给挖平了。

一队人在拆庇护所的后墙，周凛要把后墙拆掉，改装成一个大门。

一队人在清理铲车推平后的土地，让这条通道尽量平坦。

天明之前，人们就高效率地把这条快速通道给修好了。

从山洞直直下坡，直通庇护所新建的后门，能够最快抵达庇护所。

若是出现任何危机，都能第一时间出兵。

工作过的人们疲惫地回到山洞，栽到床上，昏睡过去。

次日，刘班长早早起了床，他负责管理山洞后的整个厨房。

他抓了把糠，又抓了些玉米面，用水搅拌粘稠，喂给养在山洞后门，小溪旁边的鸡。

这几只鸡是林殊当初抓来的，现在已经长成成年鸡了。

刘班长平时精心照料，它们一个个白白胖胖的。

“好好吃饭，以后多下点蛋，这一山洞的人的营养可都靠你们啦～”

刘班长对着几只鸡喃喃自语，眼里是掩饰不住的喜爱。

小鸡们都跑到食槽边抢食，鸡窝那边空了。

刘班长轻轻一瞥，忽然看到了什么。

他不敢置信地揉揉眼睛。

那，那是！

那是一个鸡蛋！

一个白色的，圆润的小鸡蛋。

刘班长兴高采烈，小心翼翼地捧起这枚鸡蛋。

他兴冲冲地，带着鸡蛋跑出去。

可没看到周军官，把嘴闭严实，又悄悄退了回来。

周军官没发话，他可不敢把鸡下蛋的事告诉大家。

看着手心这枚小小的蛋，刘班长自己心里乐开了花。

别看这蛋小，鸡第一次下蛋都小，以后会越来越大，越来越成熟的。

笼子里的四只鸡，三只母鸡，一只公鸡。

刘班长心情舒畅地哼起了小曲儿，日子真是越来越有盼头了。

他再一次走出厨房冒头，终于看见了周凛。

赶忙把这个好消息告诉了他。

周凛自然是难以掩饰的喜悦。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Usually everyone walks around.

Because there is a large earth bag between the back wall and the cave.

The soldier who was good at driving a forklift drove the forklift and dug up the dirt bag in just a few strokes.

A team of people were tearing down the back wall of the shelter. Zhou Lin wanted to tear down the back wall and convert it into a gate.

A team of people were clearing the land that had been bulldozed by forklifts to make the passage as smooth as possible.

Before dawn, people efficiently repaired this expressway.

The fastest way to reach the shelter is to go straight downhill from the cave to the newly built back door of the shelter.

If any crisis occurs, troops can be dispatched immediately.

The people who had worked returned to the cave tiredly, fell on the bed, and fell asleep.

The next day, Squad Leader Liu got up early. He was responsible for managing the entire kitchen behind the cave.

He grabbed a handful of chaff and some cornmeal, stirred it into a thick consistency with water, and fed it to the chickens that were kept by the creek at the back door of the cave.

These chickens were caught by Lin Shu and have now grown into adult chickens.

Monitor Liu usually takes good care of them, and they are all white and fat.

"Eat well and lay more eggs in the future. The nutrition of the people in this cave depends on you~"

Monitor Liu murmured to himself to a few chickens, with unconcealable love in his eyes.

The chickens all ran to the trough to grab food, and the chicken coop was empty.

Monitor Liu glanced lightly and suddenly saw something.

He rubbed his eyes in disbelief.

That, that is!

That's an egg!

A white, round little egg.

Monitor Liu was very happy and carefully picked up the egg.

He happily ran out with the eggs.

But he didn't see Officer Zhou, so he shut his mouth tightly and quietly retreated.

Officer Zhou didn't say anything. He didn't dare to tell everyone about the chicken laying eggs.

Looking at the small egg in the palm of his hand, Squad Leader Liu felt happy.

Even though the egg is small, the first time a chicken lays an egg, it will become bigger and bigger and more mature.

There are four chickens in the cage, three hens and one rooster.

Squad leader Liu hummed a ditty in a happy mood, and the days were getting more and more promising.

He walked out of the kitchen again and finally saw Zhou Lin.

I quickly told him the good news.

Zhou Lin was naturally unable to conceal her joy.
